# SonarQube Rule Configurator Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > QA > SonarQube

## Overview

Configures SonarQube quality profiles with custom rules, severity settings, and language-specific analysis for code quality enforcement

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [sonarqube-rule-configurator-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
sonarqube-rule-configurator-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@sonarqube-rule-configurator` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Create custom quality profiles
- Configure rule severity and parameters
- Manage language-specific rule sets
- Implement custom coding rules

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Quality Profiles**: Profile management and customization
- **Rule Configuration**: Rule severity and parameter settings
- **Language Plugins**: Language-specific analyzer configuration
